confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors are cross-checked against several guides and a Numbeo-derived index, so they are reasonably firm. Drink anchors rest on scattered venue listings, and the wine-by-the-glass figure is an inference from those listings rather than a citywide average. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates only; no accommodation prices were searched or inspected. The FX value came from RBA page excerpts in search results, and I did not independently confirm the 16 October observation. Third-party mid-October rates differ slightly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. San Juan is a US territory that prices in USD, so it was benchmarked against US urban tourist-area pricing and Caribbean cost-of-living indexes. Restaurant anchors draw on guide averages and a Numbeo-derived index. Drink anchors draw on Old San Juan, Condado and hotel bar listings. Wine by the glass was estimated from hotel and rum-bar glass prices.
